1.explanation:
The files listed fall into several categories:

1. src/menu/view/item.jsx, src/menu/view/menu.jsx: The Menu and Menu Item components render menu items, which are at the core of this bug. The logic for adding the title attribute by default, or rendering tooltips based on children content, would reside here.
2. src/select/option.jsx, src/select/base.jsx: Select dropdown items that show similar behavior to menu items, as seen in the bug scenario images. Their rendering logic must be adjusted for the title behavior.
3. src/cascader/item.jsx, src/cascader/menu.jsx, src/cascader-select/cascader-select.jsx: Components for cascader menus, which involve nested menu items needing updates to avoid duplicate tooltips.
4. src/transfer/view/transfer-item.jsx: The Transfer component also uses menu-like items and can have the same problem where the title attribute is applied unnecessarily.
5. The corresponding index.jsx files for Menu, Select, Cascader, Cascader-Select, and Transfer (src/menu/index.jsx, src/select/index.jsx, etc.) are likely to export or wrap the buggy items and may need to pass new props/logic if the behavior is made configurable or globally toggled.
These files are related because they all deal with rendering interactive list/menu items where tooltip/title/aria attributes must be managed to balance accessibility and user experience, according to the bug report and images provided.
1.bug_scenario: The bug scenario involves the default use of the HTML 'title' attribute on menu and dropdown items in a UI library. The current implementation automatically adds a title attribute, resulting in tooltips that duplicate visible text, violating WCAG guidelines against redundant content and negatively affecting user experience, especially for screen reader and keyboard users. The scenario images illustrate menu and dropdown items where the title tooltip appears with the same text as the item, causing unnecessary repetition and interfering with usability and accessibility.

2.explanation: The bug is about conditional rendering of the title attribute for menu items and select options based on the content and truncation. In the repository, the most relevant implementation files are in the 'menu' and 'select' component directories. Specifically: 'src/menu/view/item.jsx' and 'src/menu/view/menu.jsx' define menu items and their render logic, including title/tooltip logic; 'src/menu/index.jsx' aggregates the menu logic. Likewise, 'src/select/option.jsx' (and possibly 'src/select/index.jsx') handle select dropdown option rendering and manage the title attribute as seen in the screenshots. These files are bug related because they control both the display of the title attribute and the user interaction behavior described by the bug report.
2.bug_scenario: The bug is about the default behavior of the title attribute on menu and select dropdown items. When a user hovers over a menu item, if the innerText matches the title, a tooltip appears showing the same text, which is redundant and violates accessibility best practices (WCAG's no duplicate text rule). However, for items with truncated/overflowed text, tooltips (title attribute) are useful to show the full value. The screenshots illustrate this: for some items, a tooltip appears regardless of truncation, creating redundancy.
